positive_basis.basis_quotation: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Faith has over seventy branches or over sixty branches, the most excellent of which is the declaration that there is no god but Allah, and the lowest of which is the removal of what is harmful from the path; and modesty is a branch of faith."

atoms.text: ينص الحديث على أن الله يرحم من عباده الرحماء.

positive_basis.basis_quotation: عن أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما قال: رُفع إلى رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - ابن ابنته وهو في الموت، ففاضت عينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال له سعد: ما هذا يا رسول الله؟! قال: «هذه رحمة جعلها الله تعالى في قلوب عباده، وإنما يرحم الله من عباده الرحماء».

atoms.text: The Hadith describes a reward for each letter recited from the Book of Allah, with one good deed for each letter and the good deed multiplied tenfold.

positive_basis.basis_quotation: ‘Abdullāh ibn Mas‘ūd (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Whoever recites a letter from the Book of Allah will be credited with a good deed for it, and a good deed is multiplied tenfold. I am not saying that 'Alif-Lām-Mīm' is one letter, but Alif is a letter, Lām is a letter, and Mīm is a letter."

atoms.text: The Hadith encourages prompt iftar rather than needless delay.
يسأل المستخدم عمّا إذا كان النبي قد أمر في حديث بأن نصلي كما رأيناه يصلي.
The Hadith establishes a general rule prohibiting a Muslim from shunning another Muslim for more than three nights.

positive_basis.basis_quotation: Abu Ayyūb al-Ansāri (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "It is unlawful for a Muslim to desert his fellow Muslim for more than three nights. As they meet, both of them turn their backs on each other. But the best of them is the one who starts by greeting the other."

atoms.text: يذكر الحديث أن الله يرضى عن العبد الذي يحمده بعد الأكل أو الشرب.

positive_basis.basis_quotation: عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللهَ لَيَرْضَى عَنِ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الْأَكْلَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا، أَوْ يَشْرَبَ الشَّرْبَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا».
